title: LED Downlight Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Client: Mr. & Mrs. Smith, 12 Acacia Avenue, Burleigh Heads, QLD. Job: Replace existing twenty-eight (28) halogen downlights and install six (6) new downlights in previously unlit areas of a three-bedroom, two-bathroom brick veneer home, for a total of thirty-four (34) new LED downlights. All downlights to be 90mm cut-out, 10W, CCT selectable (3000K/4000K/5500K), IC-4 rated, with four (4) of these also IP44 rated for bathrooms. Supply and install one (1) Clipsal Iconic 400W LED trailing edge dimmer switch in the living room. Approximately one hundred and fifty (150) linear metres of 1.5mm2 TPS cable. Supply and install all necessary junction boxes, connectors, and cable ties. Minor ceiling plaster patching and paint touch-ups around existing halogen cut-outs as required. Disposal of old fittings.
workingDetail: LED downlights (IC-rated), LED drivers / transformers, Dimmer switch (trailing edge), Electrical cable (TPS)
